dataify-router: Route broad research, search, scraping, monitoring, marketplace, social, travel, jobs, maps, and competitive-intelligence requests to the smallest suitable Dataify skill set. Use when the user describes an outcome without naming a specific Dataify API or scraper.
dataify-task-operations: Monitor a Dataify Builder task through completion, recover safely after interruption, or guide cross-platform DATAIFY_API_TOKEN setup. Use automatically after scraper submission, when the user provides an existing task ID, or asks how to configure the token. Do not use when the user explicitly requests submission-only behavior.
dataify-task-result: Download the JSON result of a completed Dataify scraper task. Use when status is successful or the user asks to retrieve results for a known task ID. Do not use merely to check whether a task is still running.
dataify-task-status: Check whether a known Dataify scraper task is processing, successful, or failed. Use when the user supplies a task ID and asks for its state. Do not use to submit a scraper or download a completed result.
dataify-web-unlocker: Fetch HTML or a screenshot from a known blocked or JavaScript-rendered webpage with Dataify Web Unlocker. Use for CAPTCHA-protected, dynamic, or SPA pages. Do not use for search-engine discovery or platform-specific structured records.
scraper-airbnb-product-by-searchurl: Collect structured Airbnb listing results from a known Airbnb search-results URL. Use when the user provides or wants to scrape an Airbnb search URL. Do not use for general hotel discovery or Booking.com URLs.
scraper-amazon-comment: Collect Amazon product reviews from one or more known product URLs. Use for Amazon review or comment extraction. Do not use for product details, product lists, or seller profiles.
scraper-amazon-global-product: Collect Amazon global-marketplace products by product URL, category URL, keyword, or keyword plus brand. Use when the request explicitly concerns global or multi-market Amazon product data. Do not use for ordinary single-product ASIN details or keyword-and-domain product lists.
scraper-amazon-product: Collect Amazon product details by ASIN or URL, or collect standard product results by keyword, category URL, or Best Sellers URL. Do not use for reviews, seller profiles, global-marketplace collection, or keyword-and-domain product lists.
scraper-amazon-product-list: Collect Amazon product-list records by keyword and marketplace domain. Use when both list-style results and a target Amazon domain are required. Do not use for a single ASIN, product details, reviews, or global brand collection.
scraper-amazon-seller: Collect Amazon seller profile and seller information from a known seller URL. Do not use for product details, listings, or reviews.
scraper-booking-hotellist: Collect structured Booking.com hotel records from a known Booking hotel or listing URL. Use for Booking hotel details or listings. Do not use for general hotel price discovery through Google Hotels.
scraper-crunchbase-company-by-url: Collect structured Crunchbase company profiles from one or more known company URLs. Do not use for general web research or LinkedIn company URLs.
scraper-ebay-products: Collect eBay product records by product URL, category URL, keyword, or store URL. Do not use for Amazon, Walmart, or general shopping-search results.
scraper-facebook-comment-by-url: Collect comments from a known Facebook post URL. Do not use for the post body, personal profiles, or events.
scraper-facebook-events: Collect Facebook events from an event-list URL, event-search URL, or event URL. Do not use for posts, post comments, or personal profiles.
scraper-facebook-post-by-url: Collect a Facebook post and its structured post data from a known post URL. Do not use for post comments, profiles, or events.
scraper-facebook-profile-by-url: Collect a Facebook personal profile from a known profile URL. Do not use for posts, post comments, pages of events, or company data.
scraper-github-repository-by-repo-url: Collect structured GitHub repository information from one or more known repository URLs. Do not use for GitHub code search or arbitrary webpages.
scraper-glassdoor-company-by-url: Collect structured Glassdoor company information from one or more known company URLs. Do not use for job-search results or Indeed company URLs.
scraper-google-map-details: Collect structured Google Maps place or business details from a known map URL, CID, location input, or Place ID. Do not use to discover nearby places or collect reviews.
scraper-google-maps-reviews: Collect reviews and comments for a known Google Maps place URL. Do not use for place discovery or general place details without reviews.
scraper-google-play-store-reviews-by-url: Collect Google Play app reviews from a known Play Store app URL. Do not use for app discovery, rankings, or general Google Play search.
scraper-google-shopping-keywords: Collect structured Google Shopping product records in bulk by keyword. Do not use for social-media content, ordinary Google Shopping discovery, or price-search results that do not require structured bulk extraction.
scraper-indeed-companies-info: Collect Indeed company records by company-list URL, keyword, industry and state, or company URL. Do not use for Indeed job listings or Glassdoor company URLs.
scraper-indeed-job-listings: Collect structured Indeed job-posting data from a known Indeed job URL. Do not use for company profiles or broad job discovery without an Indeed URL.
scraper-instagram-comment-by-posturl: Collect comments from a known Instagram post URL. Do not use for profile data or Reel details.
scraper-instagram-profiles: Collect Instagram profile data by username or profile URL. Do not use for post comments or Reel content.
scraper-instagram-reels: Collect Instagram Reel records from a Reel URL, Reel-list URL, or website URL. Do not use for profile data, post comments, or Google Shopping products.
scraper-linkedin-company-information-by-: Collect structured LinkedIn company information from one or more known company URLs. Do not use for personal profiles, jobs, or Crunchbase URLs.
scraper-reddit-comment-by-url: Collect comments from a known Reddit post URL. Do not use for post discovery or subreddit post lists.
scraper-reddit-posts: Collect Reddit posts by post URL, keyword, or subreddit URL. Do not use when only comments from a known post are required.
scraper-tiktok-comment-by-url: Collect TikTok comments from a known TikTok content URL. Do not use for video download, profile collection, or general TikTok discovery.
scraper-twitter-profile-by-profileurl: Collect an X/Twitter profile from a known profile URL. Do not use for posts, keyword search, or arbitrary X URLs.
scraper-walmart-products: Collect Walmart product records by URL, category URL, SKU, or keyword. Do not use for Amazon, eBay, or general shopping-search results.
scraper-youtube-audio-by-url: Download or collect a YouTube audio file from a known video URL. Do not use for video files, metadata, comments, transcripts, or video discovery.
scraper-youtube-comment-by-id: Collect YouTube comments for a known video ID. Do not use for video metadata, transcripts, media downloads, or keyword discovery.
scraper-youtube-product-by-id: Collect structured metadata for one YouTube video by video ID, such as title, channel, counts, and details. Do not use for media downloads, comments, transcripts, or lists of videos.
scraper-youtube-profiles: Collect YouTube channel or profile records by channel URL or keyword. Do not use for videos, comments, transcripts, or media downloads.
scraper-youtube-transcript-by-id: Collect subtitles, captions, or transcript text for a known YouTube video ID. Do not use for video or audio files, metadata, comments, or video discovery.
scraper-youtube-video-by-url: Download or collect a YouTube video media file from a known video URL. Do not use for metadata, comments, transcripts, channel profiles, or keyword-based video discovery.
scraper-youtube-video-post: Collect YouTube video-post records by URL, search filters, hashtag, podcast URL, keyword, or Explore URL. Use for video discovery or lists. Do not use to download media files or retrieve only one video's metadata.
serp-bing-images: Search Bing Images for image results. Do not use for Bing web, news, shopping, map, or video results.
serp-bing-maps: Search Bing Maps for places or map results. Do not use for Bing web search or Google Maps structured details.
serp-bing-news: Search Bing News for current news results. Do not use for general Bing web search.
serp-bing-search: Run a general Bing web search. Do not use when the user explicitly requests Bing images, maps, news, shopping, or videos.
serp-bing-shopping: Search Bing Shopping for products and shopping results. Do not use for general Bing web search or structured marketplace scraping.
serp-bing-videos: Search Bing Videos for video results. Do not use for general Bing web search or media-file downloads.
serp-duckduckgo-search: Run a DuckDuckGo web search. Do not use when the user explicitly requests Google, Bing, or Yandex.
serp-google-ai-mode: Search with Google AI Mode when the user explicitly requests AI Mode or AI-generated Google search results. Do not use for ordinary Google SERP results.
serp-google-finance: Search Google Finance for stocks, indices, funds, currencies, or futures. Do not use for general web search or personalized financial advice.
serp-google-flights: Search Google Flights for fares and itineraries. Do not use for hotels or general travel web search.
serp-google-hotels: Search Google Hotels for hotel discovery, prices, or availability. Do not use to scrape a known Booking.com hotel URL.
serp-google-images: Search Google Images for image results. Do not use for Google Lens reverse-image search or general web results.
serp-google-jobs: Search Google Jobs for job and recruitment listings. Do not use to scrape a known Indeed job URL.
serp-google-lens: Run Google Lens or reverse-image search from an image. Do not use for text-only Google Images queries.
serp-google-local: Search Google Local for nearby businesses and local results. Do not use for a known Place ID or detailed map record.
serp-google-maps: Search Google Maps to discover places, businesses, or map results. Do not use when a known URL, CID, or Place ID requires structured details or reviews.
serp-google-news: Search Google News for current news results. Do not use for general Google web search.
serp-google-patents: Search Google Patents for patent records. Do not use for Google Scholar papers or general web results.
serp-google-play: Search Google Play for apps, rankings, or store results. Do not use to collect reviews from a known app URL.
serp-google-scholar: Search Google Scholar for academic papers and scholarly results. Do not use for patents or general web search.
serp-google-search: Run a general Google web or SERP search. Do not use when the user explicitly requests Google Images, News, Maps, Shopping, Scholar, or another specialized Google vertical.
serp-google-shopping: Search Google Shopping for product discovery, offers, and price comparison. Do not use for structured bulk product extraction by keyword.
serp-google-trends: Search Google Trends for keyword interest and trend data. Do not use for general Google web search.
serp-google-videos: Search Google Videos for video results. Do not use for YouTube media downloads or structured YouTube records.
serp-yandex-search: Run a Yandex web search. Do not use when the user explicitly requests Google, Bing, or DuckDuckGo.
